subject.title: fix: use atomic writes for crash-safety on exec approvals, restart sentinel, shell profile, and saveJsonFile

question: Should the remaining shell-profile atomic-write fix be accepted as a narrow maintainer-owned setup hardening patch for `installCompletion`?
rationale: The remaining code change is small, but it rewrites user shell startup files and this issue is already labeled for maintainer review and no new automatic fix PR.

options.title: Fix Profile Writes Narrowly
options.body: Use the existing atomic text replacement helper for missing-profile creation and profile update while preserving current profile resolution and reasonable shell-profile permissions.

options.title: Defer Profile Hardening
